Definition
[Convex function on a locally convex set] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0446 1. apph:H.20\group Convex functions A function $f:C\to \R $ is convex when $f\circ \gamma $ is convex on every constant-speed geodesic $\gamma $ contained in $C$; it is concave when $-f$ is convex.
